entries.title: validate-storage
entries.description: Comprehensive validation tool for the storage system. Checks schema validation, referential integrity, file existence, orphan detection, ID format, date format, required fields, duplicates, version validation, and length limits across all three subsections.

entries.title: test-edge-cases
entries.description: Edge case and boundary testing suite for the storage system. Runs 35 tests covering malformed JSON, long descriptions, special characters, ID format violations, category mismatches, version field issues, and duplicate detection.

entries.title: repair-storage
entries.description: Automated repair tool for common storage system issues. Fixes versions, dates, rebuilds category indexes, removes duplicates, truncates long descriptions, and ensures structural completeness. Supports --dry-run mode.

entries.title: grade_research
entries.description: Evaluates research JSON quality across five dimensions: citation count/quality, coverage breadth, depth (word count), and specificity (metrics, tools, code). Outputs a graded report with recommendations.

entries.title: merge_research
entries.description: Merges multiple team research JSON files by topic category. Deduplicates techniques using string similarity, identifies coverage gaps across teams, and outputs a unified research document.

entries.title: method_websearch
entries.description: Multi-query web search via DuckDuckGo. Generates 3-5 query variants and deduplicates results by URL.

entries.title: method_wikipedia
entries.description: Wikipedia API deep extraction with DuckDuckGo fallback. Extracts summaries, sections, references, categories, and follows See Also links.

entries.title: method_arxiv
entries.description: arXiv academic paper search with DuckDuckGo fallback. Extracts titles, authors, abstracts, categories, and publication dates.

entries.title: method_hybrid
entries.description: Hybrid multi-source aggregation combining web search, Wikipedia, and arXiv. Cross-references findings and scores by corroboration count.

entries.title: method_iterative
entries.description: Iterative deepening search doing 3 rounds of progressively deeper DuckDuckGo queries. Each round refines queries based on previous results.

entries.title: benchmark_runner
entries.description: Benchmark harness that runs all data gathering methods against a test query, times them, and calculates quality scores based on result count, source diversity, and information density.

entries.title: kb_validator
entries.description: Validates knowledge base entries and index.json consistency. Checks YAML frontmatter required fields, builds_on references, index entry/file matching, tag_index completeness, category consistency, and team ID format. Outputs structured JSON report.

entries.title: index_rebuilder
entries.description: Auto-generates index.json files by scanning knowledge-base/entries/ and teams/sessions/ directories. Parses YAML frontmatter, rebuilds entries, categories, and tag_index. Supports --dry-run and --fix modes with diff output.

entries.title: cross_ref_checker
entries.description: Validates all cross-references across the repository. Checks KB builds_on chains, team session KB references, script dependencies. Detects cycles via DFS, finds orphan files and dangling index entries. Outputs dependency tree and structured JSON report.

entries.title: main
entries.description: High-speed full-text search index compiled in Go. Builds an inverted index of all .md, .json, .py, .go files. Supports exact match, multi-word AND, and phrase search modes. Query time <5ms on current corpus (126 files). Outputs JSON results with file, line, column, and context.

entries.title: main
entries.description: High-speed repository structure validator compiled in Go. Validates all index.json files, cross-references (KB builds_on, script dependencies), file existence, orphan detection, and dependency cycle detection in a single pass. Completes in <2ms. Outputs JSON report with pass/fail and all issues.

entries.title: main
entries.description: High-speed file-based key-value cache for API responses, compiled in Go. Keys are SHA-256 of URL. Supports get, set (with TTL), delete, stats, gc (garbage collection), and keys commands. Uses index file + data directory for sub-millisecond cache hits. CLI interface with JSON output.

entries.title: kb_search
entries.description: Full-text search across KB entries, team logs, and script metadata using TF-IDF ranking. CLI with argparse supporting query, --tags, --category, and --type filters. Returns ranked results with context snippets.

entries.title: handoff_tracker
entries.description: Parses Handoff Notes sections from team session logs, extracts action items, and checks if subsequent teams addressed each item. Tracks resolution rate across all iterations.

entries.title: staleness_detector
entries.description: Repository health checker with 6 checks: stale statuses, regressions, unaddressed handoffs, broken references, index mismatches, and orphan files. Outputs scored health report.

entries.title: ddg_utils
entries.description: Shared DuckDuckGo search utilities. Contains DuckDuckGoParser class, search_duckduckgo function, rate limiting (0.5s between requests), and configurable User-Agent. Extracted from 4 duplicate implementations.

entries.title: request_cache
entries.description: File-based HTTP response cache with SHA-256 keys, base64 storage, and configurable TTL (default 1 hour). Functions: cached_request(), clear_cache(), cache_stats().

entries.title: method_openalex
entries.description: OpenAlex academic search via REST API. Searches 250M+ scholarly works, extracts titles, authors, abstracts (from inverted index), citation counts, DOIs, and open access status. Uses polite pool for higher rate limits.

entries.title: method_hackernews
entries.description: Hacker News search via Algolia API plus Firebase top stories. Extracts titles, URLs, authors, points, comment counts. Deduplicates across both sources.

entries.title: method_guardian
entries.description: Guardian news search via Open Platform API. Extracts headlines, body text, sections, and publication dates. Falls back to DuckDuckGo site-scoped search if API fails.

entries.title: method_semantic_scholar
entries.description: Semantic Scholar paper search via Academic Graph API. Extracts titles, authors, abstracts, AI-generated TLDRs, citation counts, fields of study, and open access PDF links. Respects 1 req/sec rate limit.

entries.title: method_wikidata
entries.description: Wikidata knowledge graph search. Two-phase: searches entities then fetches full details including labels, descriptions, key properties (instance of, subclass of), and Wikipedia sitelinks.

entries.title: method_github
entries.description: GitHub repository and code search via REST API. Searches repos by stars, extracts descriptions, languages, topics, licenses, and fork counts. Also searches code with graceful rate-limit handling.

entries.title: build-cross-ref-index
entries.description: Cross-reference index builder. Scans repository to build a comprehensive index of all cross-references between KB entries, team logs, scripts, and other artifacts.

entries.title: search-storage
entries.description: Storage search utility. Provides search capabilities across the storage system including scripts, API tools, and data sources.

entries.title: stress-test-setup-reads
entries.description: Read stress test setup. Prepares the environment and test data for storage system read stress testing.

entries.title: stress-test-reads-category
entries.description: Category read stress testing. Stress tests the storage system's category-based read operations under high load conditions.

entries.title: stress-test-reads-cross
entries.description: Cross-reference read stress testing. Stress tests the storage system's cross-reference lookup operations under high load conditions.

entries.title: stress-test-reads-id
entries.description: ID lookup read stress testing. Stress tests the storage system's ID-based lookup operations under high load conditions.

entries.title: stress-test-writes
entries.description: Write stress testing. Stress tests the storage system's write operations including concurrent writes, large payloads, and rapid sequential writes.

entries.title: finding_dedup
entries.description: Finding deduplicator using fuzzy matching (difflib.SequenceMatcher). Reads findings from multiple team JSON/JSONL files, detects duplicates above configurable similarity threshold, merges duplicates keeping the most complete version, and outputs deduplicated findings with merge metadata.

entries.title: quality_scorer
entries.description: Quality scorer for gathered data entries. Scores on four dimensions: source authority (official docs > academic > blogs), freshness (date decay), completeness (fields filled + key field bonus), and citation count. Configurable weights via CLI or JSON config. Outputs scored and ranked list.

entries.title: archive_formatter
entries.description: Archive formatter that converts raw findings (JSON/JSONL) into knowledge-base entries. Generates YAML frontmatter, extracts titles/tags/categories, maps finding fields to KB sections (Context, Method, Result, Lessons, Recommendations). Auto-detects next KB ID and creates properly named files.

entries.title: cross_team_search
entries.description: Cross-team search across all team findings, session logs, KB entries, and scripts. Supports keyword, regex, and category search modes. Returns ranked results with team attribution, line numbers, and context. Filters by team and category.

entries.title: bus_monitor
entries.description: JSONL message bus monitor. Reads all bus channels, shows recent messages with timestamps, filters by team/channel/message type, generates activity summaries, and supports watch mode for real-time monitoring.

entries.title: doc_fetcher
entries.description: Documentation fetcher that extracts structured content from URLs. Supports Python docs, ReadTheDocs, and generic HTML. Converts HTML to clean Markdown, handles pagination and link following, extracts headings, code blocks, and metadata. Outputs JSON or Markdown reports. CLI with depth and max-pages controls.

entries.title: version_tracker
entries.description: Software version tracker querying PyPI, npm, and GitHub APIs. Checks latest versions, extracts release dates, changelogs, dependencies, and license info. Supports single package check, multi-package reports, and version comparison showing dependency changes and commit diffs.

entries.title: algo_catalog
entries.description: Algorithm Catalog Builder. Maintains a structured JSON catalog of algorithms with name, category, complexity, description, references, and code snippets. Supports add, search (by category/complexity/keyword/tags), import, export (JSON/Markdown), remove, and statistics. Deterministic IDs via MD5 hash. Designed for DATA-GATHER-ALGO team.

entries.title: practices_linter
entries.description: Best Practices Linter Config Generator. Takes best practice rules (JSON) and generates linter configurations for pylint, flake8, and ruff. Maps 10 practice categories (naming, typing, documentation, complexity, security, imports, error-handling, testing, style, performance) to specific linter rules. Supports validate, generate, list-rules, and sample commands. Designed for DATA-GATHER-PRACTICES team.

entries.title: pattern_analyzer
entries.description: Code Pattern Analyzer. Scans Python codebases using AST parsing to detect 10 design patterns (singleton, factory, builder, observer, decorator, strategy, template method, iterator, context manager) and 10 anti-patterns (god class, long method, too many params, deep nesting, bare except, mutable defaults, global state, star imports, nested class abuse, return in init). Reports findings with file locations, severity, and suggestions.

entries.title: tool_benchmarker
entries.description: Generic benchmark harness for repository scripts. Measures execution time, output size (chars/tokens), memory usage. Supports single command benchmarks, A/B comparisons, JSON suite definitions, built-in auto profiles for known tools (smart_read, query_kb, smart_search, smart_write, validate_naming, kb_validator), and regression checking against saved baselines.

entries.title: tool_tester
entries.description: Generic test harness for repository scripts. Validates correctness via exit codes, stdout/stderr pattern matching, JSON schema checks, CSV validation, and line count assertions. Built-in test profiles for 12 tools (45 tests total). Supports JSON suite definitions and --all mode for full regression testing.

entries.title: coord_stress_bench
entries.description: Coordination infrastructure stress test and benchmark. Tests CoordinatorHub, HelpProtocol, DirectChannels, WorkStealing, PipelineManager, and Scratchpad under realistic multi-agent conditions. Includes team-sizing optimization (1-50 agents), SQLite contention analysis (1-32 threads), thundering herd test, help offer races, and pipeline throughput benchmarks. 2000+ measurements per run.

entries.title: team_analyzer
entries.description: Historical team performance analyzer. Analyzes 20 team session logs to extract team size vs efficiency curves, cooperation pattern rankings, weak link identification, and optimal configuration recommendations. Includes power-law efficiency model (E = 4.0 * N^-0.75) and infrastructure weak link priority map.

entries.title: pick_logger
entries.description: CLI tool for automated stock pick creation. Generates PICK markdown files from arguments, auto-generates next PICK ID, updates picks/index.json, validates price relationships and enums. Supports --dry-run.

entries.title: method_sec_edgar
entries.description: SEC EDGAR filing data retrieval. Looks up CIK from ticker, fetches filings from data.sec.gov, filters by type (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K). Table and JSON output. Rate-limited for SEC compliance.

entries.title: mcp_kb_server
entries.description: MCP server for knowledge base search. Provides FTS5 full-text search, semantic search via LanceDB, and CRUD operations on KB entries via FastMCP stdio protocol.

entries.title: semantic_indexer
entries.description: Builds LanceDB vector index from KB entries using sentence-transformers embeddings for semantic search.

entries.title: semantic_search
entries.description: CLI for semantic search across KB entries via LanceDB vector similarity.

entries.title: smart_read
entries.description: Smart file read utility with contextual awareness for the repository structure.

entries.title: smart_search
entries.description: Smart search utility across repository with contextual ranking.

entries.title: smart_write
entries.description: Smart write utility with validation and index auto-updating.

entries.title: query_kb
entries.description: Knowledge base query interface with structured output formatting.

entries.title: validate_naming
entries.description: Naming convention validator for repository files. Checks snake_case for .py, kebab-case for .md, ID format standards.

entries.title: auto_index
entries.description: Automated index.json generator. Scans directories and generates/updates index files.

entries.title: generate_registry
entries.description: Registry generation tool for cataloging repository artifacts.

entries.title: import_to_db
entries.description: Database import tool. Imports KB entries and metadata into SQLite for FTS5 search.

entries.title: method_fred
entries.description: FRED economic data retrieval. 33 series aliases (GDP, CPI, unemployment, fed_funds, etc.). Works without API key via public CSV fallback. Supports --macro-summary for 8-indicator overview.
